title: Skai > Predict - full (768 x 1024px)
notes: Full-scroll root at mobile (10509-18308) and tablet (10642-185390): search row, horizontally scrolling category nav, single-column card list, "Show more markets", then an FAQ accordion. title: Skai > Predict > Dashboard 1VH (375x812px)
notes: Cites 3562-40397 + 3554-10890; routed at App.tsx:957. ★ CORRECTED 2026-08-19: REDESIGN_PREDICT is LIVE. The build-time default in src/config/features.ts:210 is still false, but the feature_flags row is enabled=true / rollout=100 (set 2026-08-05) and the table wins over the bundle, so this HAS been visible in production since then. The old note read as 'nobody can see this yet', which is how a shipped surface went eleven days without a report - and then took nine at once on 2026-08-19. Read the ROW, never the FEATURES constant. TWO FIXES 2026-08-05. (1) The 'AI Analysis' CTA rendered DISABLED on the stated grounds that no destination surface exists; that was false - HomeDeepLinkHandler in home-redesign/RedesignHome.tsx consumes ?prompt= and auto-sends it into the shared chat engine, and both the Portfolio 'AI Analysis' CTA and Predict > Rewards 'Ask SKAI AI' (designer note 3558-39692) already ship on that contract. It is now a live control on the same deep link. Because ?prompt= auto-sends, the only variable in the prompt is a DASHBOARD_TABS label, a module constant - never a market title or anything a user typed. (2) The mobile/tablet frames (10635-79861, 10657-217688) collapse that CTA to a compact square icon button beside the title; the button is now square below md and the full pill from md up, one element with a responsive label and an aria-label that does not shrink with the layout. Still not reproduced, no backend: the frame's candidate photos, world map, EPS earnings calendar, Oscars hero banner, page footer, and a Geo-politics section absent from OVERVIEW_SECTIONS. 2026-08-19 (reports b320148f / 0622e026 / 62d71bee): the CTA is now measured to CTA/button 3562:40405 - 158x36, 8px radius (the node's `rounded-lg` token is 8; THIS app's rounded-lg is 12px, so the class is rounded-sm), 34.5px side padding, and FigmaSparkleIcon rather than lucide `Sparkles`. The logos/skai watermark is now one flat colour: SkaiLogo gained a `monochrome` prop because `variant` only ever set the WORDMARK fill, so the bolt stayed brand Sky Blue - measured rgb(45,75,85) on the live page against rgb(75,89,88) in the Figma export of the same node. The hero CHART is still the empty state and that is data, not code: outcome_trades and scalar_trades are both zero-row, and DashboardHeroChart reads outcome_trades directly.
